items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Walter, Mingus, Teddy and myself, it was just a quartet.

ctx.x: Who else was in that group? Who was on drums…

There was a drummer named Walter Bolden. Walter, Mingus, Teddy and myself, it was just a quartet. The jobs I made with Teddy were just a quartet all the time. New Directions, it never really took off. It never really left the ground. Certain devices like changing the tempo, speeding up and slowing down, contrapuntal stuff that later on became known as the new thing, we were doing that back then.
Yeah. It was a hell of a lesson. But I wrote it in quarter/quantotriplets.
Yeah, I assumed so, yeah, yeah. I have to listen to that again. Did you have any problem with -- that band was only partially a jazz band, wasn't it?
Yeah. Art Farmer, John LaPorta Porter --
